article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso repatriates more than 8,000 nationals of Guinea after the ban on gold panning
article_manifest.original_title: Le Burkina Faso rapatrie plus de 8.000 ressortissants de Guinée après l’interdiction de l’orpaillage
article_manifest.summary: Burkina Faso repatriates more than 8,000 nationals from Guinea after gold panning ban The Burkinabe government has mobilized a convoy of hundreds of buses to repatriate more than 8,000 nationals from Guinea, in response to the ban on artisanal gold mining and a situation of increasing distress Burkina Faso is organizing the repatriation of thousands of its nationals from Guinea this week, after measures taken by Conakry against illegal gold panning, AFP learned Wednesday from a source in the Burkinabe government and a state media.

article_manifest.title: Niono, Tessalit and Gourma-Rharous:...
article_manifest.original_title: Niono, Tessalit et Gourma-Rharous :...
article_manifest.summary: Niono, Tessalit and Gourma-Rharous: the Noose is tightening around terrorist groups As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, carried out airstrikes in different localities of our country between 2 and 3 November 2026 . In a statement issued yesterday by the General Staff of the Armed Forces, it appears that on Monday, November 2, 2026, the use of precise information made it possible to locate, thirty kilometers east of Niono, a major base housing armed terrorist groups as well as war material, including armed vehicles.

article_manifest.title: Kangaba: Six dead in the landslide...
article_manifest.original_title: Kangaba : Six morts dans l’éboulement...
article_manifest.summary: Kangaba: Six dead in the landslide of a mining well in Nouga Six people died last Friday in the landslide of a mining well, transformed into a gallery, in the rural commune of Nouga, precisely on a very isolated gold mining site in the village of Dioulafoundou. According to our information, the people who died are all nationals of Burkina Faso Immediately informed, the Prefect of Circle, accompanied by the officials of the Police, the National Gendarmerie, the National Guard, the Civil Protection Rescue Center, the sanitation and water and forest services, went to the scene.

article_manifest.title: Guinea: 22 directors expelled for complicity in illegal gold panning in Siguiri
article_manifest.original_title: Guinée : 22 administrateurs radiés pour complicité d’orpaillage illégal à Siguiri
article_manifest.summary: Guinea: 22 directors removed for complicity in illegal gold panning in Siguiri The Guinean President, Mamadi Doumbouya, signed on November 3, 2026 a decree deleting 22 territorial administrators, civilian and military, stationed in the Siguiri region. They are permanently excluded from the civil service and the defence and security forces The spokesman of the Presidency, General Amara Camara, read the decree on national television (RTG).

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Mali-Guinea: an influx of foreign nationals reported at the border
article_manifest.original_title: Mali-Guinée : un afflux de ressortissants étrangers signalé à la frontière
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, November 4 (AMAP) A large influx of nationals of various nationalities is currently observed at the border between Mali and Guinea, towards the District of Bamako, announced Wednesday the Crisis Coordination and Management Center (CECOGEC), in a statement of the Inter-Ministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management This situation follows the measures taken by the Guinean authorities to put an end to clandestine and illegal gold panning on their territory, says the communiqué issued at the end of an emergency meeting held at the Ministry of Security and Civil Protection, under the chairmanship of…

article_manifest.title: Moscow: Assimi Goïta hits the spotlight during a shooting demonstration
article_manifest.original_title: Moscou : Assimi Goïta fait mouche lors d’une démonstration de tir
article_manifest.summary: Moscow: Assimi Goïta hits the mark during a shooting demonstration On the sidelines of the third Russia-Africa Summit, held in Moscow on 28 and 29 October 2026, the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, participated in a shooting exercise during a military demonstration. He hit the head of the target on each of his four shots . Before becoming Head of State, Assimi Goïta spent much of his career in the Malian special forces.

article_manifest.title: Niger signs cooperation deal with military leader in eastern Libya
article_manifest.original_title: Niger signs cooperation deal with military leader in eastern Libya
article_manifest.summary: Niger signed a memorandum of understanding with eastern Libya’s military commander Khalifa Haftar on Sunday to strengthen their bilateral relations. The agreement to expand cooperation in “various fields” was approved by Nigerien Prime Minister Ali Mahaman Lamine Zeine. He visited Benghazi together with several political and military officials.

article_manifest.title: Mali-Guinea: An influx of gold miners at the Kouremale border, CECOGEC announces reception measures...
article_manifest.original_title: Mali-Guinée : Afflux des orpailleurs à la frontière Kouremale , le CECOGEC annonce des mesures d’accueil...
article_manifest.summary: Mali-Guinea: Flux of gold miners at the Kouremale border, CECOGEC announces reception and repatriation measures The Ministry of Security and Civil Protection is sounding the alarm . In a press release No. 2026-05 published on November 3, 2026 and signed by Colonel Fireman Issa Raoul Dana DABO, the Center for Coordination and Crisis Management (CECOGEC) reports a large influx of nationals of various nationalities on the border between Mali and Guinea, towards the District of Bamako .

article_manifest.title: Mali-Guinea Border Migration: Security Authorities Take Charge
article_manifest.original_title: Migration frontalière Mali-Guinée : Les autorités sécuritaires prennent la situation en main
article_manifest.summary: COMMUNIQUÉ No. 2026-05 OF the INTERMINISTERIEL Committee FOR CRISIS and DISASTER MANAGEMENT Following an emergency meeting held today at the Ministry of Security and Civil Protection chaired by the Secretary General, the Crisis Coordination and Management Center (CECOGEC) informs national public opinion that a large influx of nationals of various nationalities is currently observed at the border between Mali and the Guinea, towards Bamako District.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: Islamist Armed Group Targets Civilians
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso: Islamist Armed Group Targets Civilians
article_manifest.summary: - An Al-Qaeda-linked armed group killed at least 27 civilians in two attacks in Burkina Faso’s northern Yatenga province in September 2026. - The group’s relentless, unlawful attacks put civilians across Burkina Faso at grave risk. The laws of war prohibit attacking civilians, and those who order, commit, or assist serious violations of the laws of war with criminal intent may be prosecuted for war crimes.

article_manifest.title: An example of cooperation :
article_manifest.original_title: Un exemple de coopération
article_manifest.summary: This is an example of South-South cooperation that must do its bit on the African continent. Algeria has decided to provide military support to its neighbour, Niger, with which it had, until recently, tense relations. If relations between the two had been somewhat blurred, pragmatism eventually took over, giving way to a return to a warming of cooperation between the two countries .

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa strike terrorist positions in Niono, Tessalit and Gourma-Rharous
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les FAMa frappent des positions terroristes à Niono, Tessalit et Gourma-Rharous
article_manifest.summary: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike terrorist positions in Niono, Tessalit and Gourma-Rharous The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, continue their operations to secure the territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. The General Staff of the Armed Forces gave an update on several strikes carried out in the last two days . On Monday, November 2, 2026, accurate intelligence identified a large terrorist base 30 kilometers east of Niono.

article_manifest.title: Mali-Guinea border: influx of foreign nationals to Bamako
article_manifest.original_title: Frontière Mali-Guinée : afflux de ressortissants étrangers vers Bamako
article_manifest.summary: A large influx of people of different nationalities is currently observed at the border between Mali and Guinea, in the direction of Bamako. The information was given this Tuesday, November 3, 2026 by the Crisis Coordination and Management Centre (CECOGEC), following an emergency meeting at the Ministry of Security and Civil Protection According to the press release, these arrivals follow the measures taken by the Guinean authorities to put an end to clandestine gold panning on their territory.

article_manifest.original_title: Sahel : la guerre entre djihadistes s'intensifie

article_manifest.title: Ghana: a deadly explosion kills several people near the Burkinabe border
article_manifest.original_title: Ghana : une explosion meurtrière fait plusieurs victimes près de la frontière burkinabè
article_manifest.summary: An explosion involving a tricycle carrying suspected explosives killed several people on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, in Hamile, Upper West Region, Ghana. One immigration officer lost his life in the drama, while another was seriously injured. The locality of Hamile, located near the border between Ghana and Burkina Faso, was shaken by a deadly explosion .

article_manifest.title: Niger: 1,245 deaths in road accidents in 2025
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : 1 245 morts dans des accidents de la route en 2025
article_manifest.summary: In Niger, 1,245 people lost their lives in road accidents in 2025, according to data from the Nigerien Road Safety Agency (ANISER), reported by the Nigerien Press Agency (ANP) on November 2, 2026. According to the Director General of ANISER, Dr. Abou Mountari, 99.24% of accidents are related to human behavior .

article_manifest.title: Factory fire kills 4 and seriously injures 16
article_manifest.original_title: Un incendie dans une usine fait 4 morts et 16 blessés graves
article_manifest.summary: An explosion followed by a violent fire at Metafrique Steel's facilities, located in the Bassa industrial zone in Douala, Cameroon, left four dead and sixteen seriously injured on Monday, November 2, 2026. This tragedy comes six months after a previous disaster in the same company, already singled out for alleged breaches of safety rules. The balance sheet is particularly heavy Four people lost their lives and sixteen others were seriously burned in a fire that occurred on the morning of Monday, November 2, 2026, at the Metafrique Steel metallurgical plant in Douala, Cameroon.

article_manifest.title: Defence: presentation to the flag of the 2025 contingent of the Nigerien Armed Forces trained at the Tondibiah Training Group
article_manifest.original_title: Défense : présentation au drapeau du contingent 2025 des Forces armées nigériennes formé au Groupement d’instruction de Tondibiah
article_manifest.summary: The Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces, Brigadier General Mamane Sani Kiaou, chaired, Monday, November 2, 2026, the solemn ceremony of presentation to the flag of the 2025 contingent of new recruits of the Nigerien Armed Forces (FAN), trained at the Tondibiah Training Group, near Niamey After several months of intensive training, these new soldiers from all regions and all social strata of the country have acquired the physical, technical and tactical skills necessary to accomplish their sovereign missions in the service of the nation Now ready to defend the homeland, they officially integrate the large FAN…

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Nigeria: Five law enforcement officers killed in an ambush in the northwest
article_manifest.original_title: Nigeria : cinq agents des forces de l’ordre tués dans une embuscade dans le nord-ouest
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, Nov. 3 (AMAP) Five Nigerian law enforcement officers were killed Monday night in an ambush by gunmen on the Sokoto-Gusau axis in the northwest of the country while on their way to neighboring Zamfara state, according to a police spokesman. They were riding on a Zamfara transit bus when assailants intercepted the vehicle and opened fire Police spokesman Abdullahi Faruk confirmed the attack and said the bodies of the victims had been dropped off at the morgue at Usmanu Danfodiyo University Hospital in Sokoto.

article_manifest.title: Mali: nearly 4,000 displaced after the attack on the village of Souleye
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : près de 4.000 déplacés après l'attaque du village de Souleye
article_manifest.summary: In Mali, nearly 4,000 displaced people have found refuge in Macina and Sarro, in the Ségou region in the centre of the country. These are mainly women and children who fled the attack on the village of Souleye, carried out in early September by hundreds of jihadist fighters. On the spot, solidarity is organized, but the needs remain immense .

article_manifest.title: Gao: a young man attacked in his sleep in front of a butcher shop
article_manifest.original_title: Gao : un jeune agressé dans son sommeil devant une boucherie
article_manifest.summary: A young man was robbed while sleeping in front of a butcher shop, behind the science block, in front of the Gao hospital. According to his testimony, three armed men arrived on a motorcycle and surprised him during his sleep . They allegedly threatened him with a weapon and tried to strangle him with a turban, before seizing a large sum of money and fleeing.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: Two fiancés die in Tenkodogo after an altercation involving a firearm
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso : Deux fiancés décèdent à Tenkodogo après une altercation impliquant une arme à feu
article_manifest.summary: A trader and a non-commissioned officer of the defense and security forces, presented as fiancés, died at the Tenkodogo Regional Hospital Center (CHR) after an altercation that occurred on the night of November 1 to 2, 2026 in Sector 6, according to testimonies collected by the Burkina Faso Information Agency (AIB) . The two victims, identified as Jeanne Yoda and Adama Tiendrébéogo, allegedly had an argument near a pharmacy, not far from the hospital.

article_manifest.title: Burkina/Fight against terrorism: VDP Younga Yacouba honored for his bravery in combat
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina/Lutte antiterroriste : Le VDP Younga Yacouba honoré pour sa bravoure au combat
article_manifest.summary: Burkina Faso/Fight against terrorism: The VDP Younga Yacouba honored for his bravery in combat According to the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Burkina Faso, the Volunteer for the Defense of the Fatherland (VDP) Younga Yacouba showed courage and determination during an attack on a position in the village of Youba, where he was engaged in a support mission .

article_manifest.title: Between Us: Realism
article_manifest.original_title: Entre Nous: Réalisme
article_manifest.summary: By press release dated 24 October 2026, the General Staff of the Armed Forces announced the discovery, in a camp in Tagadayat about 35 km south-east of the city of Menaka, of 54 lifeless bodies . A week earlier, on October 19, the Executive Office of the Idaksahak Community spoke of "the massacre of 48 civilians, which occurred on Sunday, October 18, 2026, in the locality of Tagadayat, in the region of Menaka, by armed elements of Daesh, arrived on board several motorcycles" .
